{{Top|leg}}
'''Fractal-pattern armor''' was a form of body [[Armor/Legends|armor]] developed by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] during the years following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Worn by the Chiss [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], fractal-pattern armor used a specialized coating to create ever-changing patterns and [[Color/Legends|colorations]] on the surface, making it almost invisible to the naked [[Eye/Legends|eye]].
